title: dev-kit
summary: Some useful development kits for a Windows environment.
content: To streamline the setup process and minimize the hassle of reconfiguring development environment on new machines, I created this file to centralize the installation steps and download sources for all essential tools, ensuring a seamless, rapid transition whenever I switch devices.
